label: D1 after an unrewarded trial while the policy leans toward a2
explanation: Reset-gate unit that fires almost only at D1 (96% of mass; some weak GO activity, never D2), and almost only when the upcoming choice is a2 (99.6% of mass). Because the upcoming action is future, I recorded the observed correlate instead: the model policy logit already favours a2 at D1 (choice < -1.5) and the reward input is 0, meaning the previous trial went unrewarded (prev_reward=0 holds 90% of mass). Dev: P 0.63, R 0.61, F1 0.62, mass recall 0.88. The strongest activations are on the first unrewarded D1 after a run of rewarded a2 trials. Magnitude falls on consecutive unrewarded trials (about 0.96, then 0.62, then 0.40 within a window). Weak GO activations show up on a2 trials. Rate also drops a lot over the episode: 2.5x lift at trials 10-19, near zero after trial 80. Adding ep_trial < 70 raises precision to 0.83 (F1 0.66), so the unit drifts slowly across the episode. It is silent at D2, on a1 choices, and mostly silent after rewarded trials. The false positives are mostly late-episode or repeated-unrewarded D1 steps.
